description: This file defines a report parser class for generating cost ledger reports related to analytic accounts in Odoo, including methods for calculating account balances, revenues, and line details.

classes.name: account_analytic_cost_ledger
classes.description: A report parser class for generating cost ledger reports, providing methods to retrieve and calculate analytic account data within a specified date range.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up context variables and helper functions for report generation.

methods.name: _lines_g
methods.description: Fetches analytic line summaries grouped by general account within a date range, calculating debit and credit amounts.

methods.name: _lines_a
methods.description: Retrieves detailed analytic lines for a specific general account and account, calculating associated revenue and balances.

methods.name: _account_sum_debit
methods.description: Calculates total debit amount for an account within a date range.

methods.name: _account_sum_credit
methods.description: Calculates total credit amount for an account within a date range.

methods.name: _account_sum_balance
methods.description: Computes the net balance (debit minus credit) for an account over a date range.

methods.name: _account_sum_qty
methods.description: Sums the quantity of analytic lines for an account within a date range.

methods.name: _account_sum_revenue
methods.description: Retrieves total revenue for an account, accumulated during report processing.

methods.name: _account_g_sum_revenue
methods.description: Retrieves total revenue for a general account.

methods.name: _sum_debit
methods.description: Sums debit amounts across multiple accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_credit
methods.description: Sums credit amounts across multiple accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_balance
methods.description: Calculates net balance across multiple accounts over a date range.

methods.name: _sum_qty
methods.description: Sums quantities across multiple accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_revenue
methods.description: Calculates total revenue across multiple accounts.
